## Verdict

**Kelp** costs least for a team of 8, at **$168 per month**. It has the highest per-seat rate on the list, but it is the only vendor whose minimum (1 seat) falls below the team size, so the team pays for exactly 8 seats. Acme Desk and Fennel HQ both bill well above actual headcount.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Acme Desk | $11 | 20 |
| Fennel HQ | $15 | 40 |
| Kelp | $21 | 1 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 8 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Kelp:** minimum 1 < 8, so 8 seats paid. 8 × $21 = **$168 per month**. Effective rate $21.00 per person.
- **Acme Desk:** minimum 20 > 8, so 20 seats paid. 20 × $11 = **$220 per month**. Effective rate $27.50 per person ($220 ÷ 8); 12 unused seats worth $132.
- **Fennel HQ:** minimum 40 > 8, so 40 seats paid. 40 × $15 = **$600 per month**. Effective rate $75.00 per person ($600 ÷ 8); 32 unused seats worth $480.

Kelp is $52 per month cheaper than Acme Desk and $432 per month cheaper than Fennel HQ — $624 and $5,184 per year.

## Risks

**The ranking inverts with growth.** Kelp wins here only on the minimum, not on rate. Acme Desk's $220 is fixed until 20 seats, so it overtakes Kelp at 11 people (11 × $21 = $231 against $220) and stays cheaper above that. Fennel HQ's $600 floor holds until 40 seats, where it costs $15 per seat against Kelp's $21. A team expecting to grow past 10 should re-run these figures before committing.

**Price only.** The list gives per-seat rates and minimums and nothing else — no features, support tiers, usage limits, or security terms. The cheapest seat may not be a comparable product.

**Billing terms.** All figures assume monthly billing at list, as stated. Annual commitments, discounts, and onboarding or migration costs are not in the source and could change the ranking. Confirm whether minimums bind at signup or only at renewal.
